correctness.rationale: The fixed-matching edge-color pairs are iid with counts U,V,W multinomial(n;1/4,1/2,1/4), and the observed vertex counts are exactly (2U,V,V,2W). The centered coordinates X=(2V-n)/sqrt(n), Y=sqrt(2/n)(W-U) have identity covariance, so the bivariate CLT yields independent normal coordinates. Every fixed linear comparison either has nonzero linear drift or a homogeneous Gaussian half-plane limit; degenerate zero normals are treated separately. The exhibited coefficient choices realize all integer directions dX+eY/sqrt(2), giving the countable dense angle spectrum, the irrational Gaussian quadrant probability 1/4+arcsin(1/3)/(2pi), and the color-only boundary {0,1/2,1}. Recomputed all multinomial profile probabilities by enumeration of every coloring for n=1..5, including the correlation 1/3. The computation is finite corroboration, not the CLT proof.
